job.job_description:
We are looking for a highly skilled Data Scientist with expertise in Machine Learning, Forecasting, and Retail Analytics to drive business impact through advanced analytics solutions. The ideal candidate will work closely with commercial teams to translate business challenges into scalable analytical solutions and deliver actionable insights that support strategic decision-making.

Key Responsibilities
Partner with commercial teams to understand business requirements and translate them into analytical solutions.
Assess project feasibility and evaluate the operational and business impact of analytics initiatives.
Provide ongoing business analysis support for retail-focused projects, including reporting, retailer analysis, sales trend tracking, business insights, and must-sell list analysis.
Design, build, optimize, and deploy scalable statistical, machine learning, and deep learning models using advanced data mining techniques and evaluation metrics.
Architect, automate, and maintain end-to-end forecasting pipelines while managing and monitoring Apache Airflow DAGs across multiple geographies.
Own the full lifecycle of analytical models and data pipelines, including development, deployment, monitoring, and continuous improvement.
Conduct exploratory data analysis, research, and root cause analysis using AI/ML techniques to identify trends, patterns, and emerging business opportunities.
Support ad-hoc commercial requests involving data analysis, forecasting enhancements, model tuning, and retail business problem-solving.
Develop data visualizations and dashboards using appropriate programming libraries and BI tools.
Stay current with emerging technologies and industry best practices to drive innovation and technical excellence.
Collaborate cross-functionally with business, engineering, and analytics teams to deliver measurable business value.
Mandatory Skills
Python
SQL
Machine Learning
Forecasting / Time Series Modeling
Apache Airflow
Preferred Skills
Retail Analytics / FMCG / CPG Analytics
Deep Learning
Statistical Modeling
Data Visualization (Power BI, Tableau, Matplotlib, Seaborn)
Cloud Platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP)
Good-to-Have
Familiarity with Large Language Models (LLMs) and Generative AI methodologies.
Understanding of Agentic AI frameworks and orchestration workflows.
Experience with LangChain, LangGraph, AutoGen, CrewAI, or similar frameworks.
Exposure to MLOps and model deployment best practices.
Qualification
Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Engineering, Data Science, or a related field.
Strong communication and stakeholder management skills.
Experience working in cross-functional and business-facing environments.
